category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
prompt: What happened at the end of the 2013 Iron Bowl?
response: Kick Six, buddy. Alabama lined up a 57-yarder as time ran out and came up short. Auburn's Chris Davis fielded it deep in his own end zone and ran it back a hundred and nine yards for the touchdown — Auburn 34, Alabama 28, no time left on the clock. Hell of a thing to see.
